g.text: Figure 2a | Cue-aligned population timing and updated response classes

text.style: font-size: 8.9px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #56616f

g.text: Odd trials determine neuron order; held-out even trials are shown from −1 to +5 s. Functional classes are recomputed with paired 80-trial tests and BH-FDR across all 1,346 neurons.

text.style: font-size: 7px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #56616f

g.text: Heatmaps use each neuron's −5-to-0-s baseline z-score (display −2 to +4 z). Curves are class mean ± neuron SEM. Figure 2a is descriptive; waveform-class enrichment and all significance annotations are confined to Figure 2b.
